tasks.title: Sense architecture and data contract
tasks.weight_rationale: Initial planning estimate (D-078), not a recorded engineering estimate: 4 to 5 effort days, midpoint rounded up. Architecture, data model, schema and compatibility boundaries across AC-001..AC-005; the foundation for KOS-SENSE-002. Scale 1-8. To be revised as work proceeds.

tasks.title: Contract validation and synthetic-data tests
tasks.weight_rationale: Initial planning estimate (D-078), not a recorded engineering estimate: 3 to 4 effort days, midpoint rounded up. Reference validator, synthetic fixtures, negative cases and a repeatable make test-unit gate (AC-201..AC-206); consumes the contract of KOS-SENSE-001. Depends on KOS-SENSE-001. Scale 1-8. To be revised as work proceeds.

tasks.title: Deterministic frame graph and transform validation for simulated samples
tasks.weight_rationale: Initial planning estimate (D-082), not a recorded engineering estimate: 4 to 5 effort days, rounded up. New versioned transform representation (one unit-quaternion rotation form), frame-graph rules, deterministic composition and inversion, negative fixtures and a repeatable make test-unit gate (AC-301..AC-307), software only on synthetic data. Depends on KOS-SENSE-001 and KOS-SENSE-002. Scale 1-8. To be revised as work proceeds.

tasks.title: Deterministic synthetic sensor sample generator
tasks.weight_rationale: Initial planning estimate (D-083), not a recorded engineering estimate: 4 to 5 effort days, rounded down against 003 because the validators it reuses already exist. Deterministic seeded generator with a documented PRNG, valid samples for every sensor kind, explicitly requested defect cases, conformant and defective frame graphs, API and command line (AC-401..AC-407), software only on synthetic data. Depends on KOS-SENSE-001, KOS-SENSE-002 and KOS-SENSE-003. Scale 1-8. To be revised as work proceeds.

tasks.title: Telemetry stream contract and reference validator
tasks.weight_rationale: Initial planning estimate (D-087), not a recorded engineering estimate: 4 to 5 effort days, rounded down. One versioned stream contract (open, sample and close records with a record index), a JSON Schema and a standard-library stream validator with the STREAM_ code namespace for lifecycle, sequence and timestamp rules, fixtures, batching-invariance and 10,000-record correctness tests and a command line (AC-501..AC-507), software only on synthetic data, no transport. Depends on KOS-SENSE-001, KOS-SENSE-002 and KOS-SENSE-004. Scale 1-8. To be revised as work proceeds.

tasks.title: Consumer conformance harness
tasks.weight_rationale: Initial planning estimate (D-087), not a recorded engineering estimate: 5 to 6 effort days, rounded down; raised from the 4 recorded as a planning figure in D-083 after an external review found the scope is larger. A conformance harness for consumers with three operations (sample decision, stream decision, frame resolution), an independent contract-derived case set with clause references, mutants per rule class, failure isolation and a deterministic JSON result (AC-601..AC-607), software only on synthetic data, with a reference consumer under test and never used as the oracle. Depends on KOS-SENSE-001 to KOS-SENSE-005 and cannot start before KOS-SENSE-005 is accepted. Scale 1-8. To be revised as work proceeds.

tasks.title: Python package and reproducible release
tasks.weight_rationale: Initial planning estimate (D-090), not a recorded engineering estimate: 5 effort days. A versioned, installable Python package of the existing Sense software (pyproject.toml, runtime dependencies empty, pinned build tools kept apart), a version-information interface and RELEASE.md that keep the package, Sense, frame graph, stream and harness versions separate, wheel and sdist built in an isolated environment, install and smoke tests from a clean directory without the source tree, byte-for-byte reproducible builds with a fixed SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH (any difference documented), artifact hashes (AC-701..AC-707), software only on synthetic data, no publication and no contract change; a missing build tool fails CI. Depends on KOS-SENSE-001 to KOS-SENSE-006. Scale 1-8. To be revised as work proceeds.

tasks.title: Repository security and CI assurance review
tasks.weight_rationale: Initial planning estimate (D-090), not a recorded engineering estimate: 6 effort days. An internal, bounded security and CI assurance review of the Sense repository: a written threat model, review of input handling and of the dynamic consumer loading (not a sandbox), review of the CI workflows and PR gate, dependency and build configuration with an automated empty-runtime-dependency check and an offline test run, security regression tests, a findings register and a final report with every Critical and High finding fixed or dispositioned by the risk owner (AC-801..AC-807). Not a certification, penetration test or safety assessment. Depends on KOS-SENSE-001 to KOS-SENSE-006; acceptance prerequisite (not a dependency field): KOS-SENSE-007 accepted first. Scale 1-8. To be revised as work proceeds.

tasks.title: Synthetic integration gate
tasks.weight_rationale: Initial planning estimate (D-099), not a recorded engineering estimate: 6 effort days (range 5 to 8; delivery risk medium to high). A synthetic integration gate for the Sense software under V2-M2-SENSE-001: a scenario list written before the tests with a machine-checkable mapping, deterministic scenarios across generator, validator, frame graph, stream checker, a synthetic reference producer and consumer fixture (not a real consumer) and the conformance harness, the installed command lines chained through standard input and output, failure propagation with the documented exit codes, and make test-integration as a real gate that fails on a missing, duplicated, unreferenced or skipped scenario (AC-901..AC-907). Software only, synthetic data, offline, no hardware or real consumer. Depends on KOS-SENSE-001 to KOS-SENSE-008, all accepted. Scale 1-8. To be revised as work proceeds.

tasks.title: Regression gate and compatibility suite
tasks.weight_rationale: Initial planning estimate (D-099), not a recorded engineering estimate: 5 effort days (range 4 to 7; delivery risk medium). A regression gate and compatibility suite for the Sense software under V2-M2-SENSE-001: a regression inventory mapping accepted behaviour and fixed defects to tests, mutation evidence for F-001 to F-003 of KOS-SENSE-008, pinned normative artifacts of contracts 0.1.0 (the selected regression baseline, not a stable external API) with golden cases, protection of the six console entry points, golden determinism results, make test-regression as a real gate, and the aggregate make test that runs the unit, integration and regression gates and shows them separately (AC-1001..AC-1007). make acceptance stays out of scope. Depends on KOS-SENSE-001 to KOS-SENSE-008, all accepted; acceptance prerequisite (not a dependency field): KOS-SENSE-009 accepted first. Scale 1-8. To be revised as work proceeds.

tasks.title: Motion command and state contract
tasks.weight_rationale: Initial planning estimate (DRAFT, owner to approve), not a recorded engineering estimate: 5 effort days (range 4 to 7; delivery risk medium). The Motion architecture, decision register and normative contract v0.1.0-draft with five JSON schemas, error codes and a conformance test plan under V2-M1-MOTION-001 (AC-001..AC-005), merged in kritva-motion (PR #9). Documents and schemas only; no runtime, simulator or physical validation. Scale 1-8. To be revised as work proceeds.

tasks.title: Command validation, limit enforcement and fault-path tests
tasks.weight_rationale: Initial planning estimate (DRAFT, owner to approve), not a recorded engineering estimate: 5 effort days (range 4 to 7; delivery risk medium). A reference validator and its tests for the Motion contract under V2-M2-MOTION-001: configuration validation, the fixed admission order, limit enforcement, joint-state preconditions on supplied snapshots, executable schema cases and a machine-checked test-to-contract mapping, with make test-unit as a real gate (AC-201..AC-207). Software only, deterministic, offline, no hardware, no lifecycle or termination state machine. Depends on KOS-MOTION-001. Scale 1-8. To be revised as work proceeds.
